project_info.name: DutchBay Hybrid Wind+Solar
project_info.location: Dutch Bay, Kalpitiya, Puttalam District, Sri Lanka

created_by: M3 hybrid (canonical wind bankable export + pvlib-modelled solar P50/P90 on a frozen PVGIS TMY, #529)
notes: Combined bankable AEP for the 209.6 MW hybrid = wind 464.3 GWh (15 x IEA-10MW-198 via wind_resource.bankable_aep, incl. a 2.0% pre-construction P50 over-prediction haircut from the modelled 473.8; ERA5-fitted Weibull A=8.199/k=2.665; PyWake 7.28% wake; 14.48% total losses) + solar 73.8 GWh (50 MW fixed-tilt, Kalpitiya, pvlib-MODELLED P50 CF 0.1685 from solar_resource.pv_producer on a FROZEN PVGIS TMY — hourly GHI/DNI/DHI + hourly Faiman ambient temp/wind; #529 SOLAR-6/12 re-baseline from 0.179, -5.9%: real GHI 1871 vs the declared 2000 + hot-hour thermal. Prior: #469 0.20->0.179 clear-sky+scalar). Net CF 0.292997 over 209.6 MW nameplate reconciles with capacity_mw*capacity_factor (the engine bills revenue off that). The per-tech split drives the lender reporting (generation.technologies). Combined net P90-1yr 471.0 = wind 404.4 + solar 66.6, the solar component MODELLED via solar_resource.exceedance (default IEA-PVPS Task 13 budget, sigma ~7.65%). P90 BINDS the gearing here (Financing_Terms.bind_downside true, D4.6): the P90/P50 ratio 471.0/538.1 = 0.8753 rescales CFADS to size the debt, so this P90 drives the financed equity-IRR / LLCR / DSCR / balloon (no longer reporting-only).
